result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major missing image element and a major layout overflow problem with truncated content.

issues.description: Broken/missing image in 'Popular right now' section - Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a broken image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant photo
issues.suggestion: Load and display the actual restaurant image for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, or implement proper image error handling with a fallback image

issues.description: Horizontal overflow/truncation in 'Fastest near you' section - The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) is cut off on the right side and partially hidden
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards in the horizontal carousel are fully visible, either by adjusting card width, using proper scrolling, or reducing content padding/margins
